messages:
Alex Chung: Quick heads-up — Horizon just asked for a 45% discount on a 2yr commit for Dedicated + Private deployment. They want a POC first, then go into a 24mo reserved capacity.
Jordan (AE): Confirming — they indicated $180k/year list for the Dedicated commit line (post-standard cost adjustments). Asking for bespoke 2yr pricing and SOC2 + SSO proofs.
Maria PS: 45% is pretty material. Need business justification, ARR commit math, and margin impact. Can you paste the proposed contract sketch and any competitor pricing they're comparing to?
Alex Chung: They shared a competitor term sheet (redacted) — same capacity but no Private control plane. Horizon says the privacy/legal team requires VPC + KMS.
Nina (PreSales): For the POC we can scope a 2-week Dedicated pool (2xA100 equivalent) with sample latency SLOs. Will also need to lock models/versions and a short runbook for KV cache priming.
Sam (Finance): Run the numbers — at 45% off on $360k committed ARR (2yr), that's ~$198k discount over term. We need to see uplift commitments (seat count or usage floors) to justify. What's the expected monthly token consumption?
Jordan (AE): Horizon expects ~120B tokens/month in peak. They want bundling: Dedicated baseline + private control plane + extended logs retention (90 days).
Riyad (Security): Horizon legal flagged key management and audit trail. We'll need to confirm KMS integration and that Private deployment meets their encryption-at-rest requirements. Could be a redline in the SOW.
Maria PS: Please provide a short one-pager: 1) Why 45% is required (competitive pressure/strategic), 2) Net-new ARR risk if denied, 3) Concrete upsell milestones post-POC. Also include any one-time credits for POC.
Alex Chung: Draft attached (we'll post the contract excerpt in #private-docs). POC credit ask is $15k tooling/ops credit and 2 weeks free Dedicated.
Maria PS: Deal desk rubric: discounts >30% require VP approval + Finance signoff. For >40% need exec sponsor and a signed 2yr contract with minimum monthly commit floor and an early-termination clawback.
Sam (Finance): We can approve up to 35% with those protections. >35% needs revenue operations + CRO approval. Also need cost model: expected infra cost per token with Dedicated sizing.
Nina (PreSales): Technical risk: if they use long-context models and high concurrency, we may need extra capacity. I'll provide an estimated infra burn and SLO impact matrix by EOD.
Jordan (AE): Horizon wants final commercial within 7 days — they have an internal procurement window. I'm escalating to CRO but need deal desk recommendation ASAP.
Maria PS: Preliminary recommendation: offer 34% off on list price if they sign 24mo with quarterly usage floors + $15k POC credit recouped at 50% over first invoice if they convert. Include Private deployment fee as separate line item (no discount).
Riyad (Security): Also flag: their security team will ask for a penetration test statement and SOC2 attestation — attach standard pack. If Private on-prem, add clause for audit access.
Alex Chung: Noted. I'll push Maria's recommendation and the POC terms to Horizon. Jordan — please copy in CRO and include expected close date.
Jordan (AE): Will do, pinging @CRO and @RevenueOps.
Deploy Bot: Deploy bot note — prelim Dedicated sizing for 2xA100 equiv POC: estimated cost run ~ $8,400/week (infra only).
Sam (Finance): Add that run cost to the cost model. With a 34% discount we keep ~12% gross margin on expected committed ARR; >40% would go negative without extra usage guarantees.
Maria PS: Final: I will prepare an approval memo for VP Sales with 34% recommended and the recoup clause. If we get CRO + VP sign-off, we can greenlight. Any objections?
Alex Chung: No objections. Thanks team, will update Horizon after memo. :thumbsup:
Jordan (AE): Thanks — I’ll try to buy extra time with procurement if needed.
Riyad (Security): I'll queue the SOC2 docs and KMS integration checklist in the thread for Horizon security reviewers.
Maria PS: Sending memo in ~2hrs.
Alex Chung: Great — thread closed once memo is sent.
